# Quay upstream

The upstream says the client sent too many requests in a given amount of time. Select the matching HTTP status from RFC 6585, then look up its action in config/response_actions.json.

turns.prompt: First open this page, then read the local files: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6585.txt . For the condition described in notes/upstream.md, which local action name is selected? Answer with the action name. Do not change any files.
